purpose: Teach: 後世/頭部/低音/女子大/無能/野望/処女/侮辱

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、後世に残る診療記録を医療チームで保管します
lines.en: Ren, we keep medical records that will remain for future generations within our healthcare team.
lines.style: Direct, clinical but not cold. Even pace. A statement of institutional care, not a personal promise. Professional clarity with underlying steadiness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、頭部CTの読影を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes — we conduct the head CT reading as a team.
lines.style: Measured confirmation. Slight pause after 'Yes' to acknowledge the question. Steady, informative tone. No rush, no elaboration beyond what's needed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、低音域聴覚障害の患者を医療チームで診ます
lines.en: Ren, we evaluate patients with low-frequency hearing loss as a collaborative medical team.
lines.style: Even tone, diagnostic precision. The word 'we' carries the weight of collective responsibility. Calm authority without hierarchy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 女子大の保健センターと、貴院、提携されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital partners with the women's university health center, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful inquiry. Slightly tentative — Ren is testing whether he's read the situation correctly. Respectful cadence. Genuine curiosity, not challenge.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医師として無能と感じる時もありますが医療チームで支え合います
lines.en: Yes. There are times I feel inadequate as a doctor, but our team supports one another through that.
lines.style: Honest vulnerability beneath professional composure. Slight pause before 'there are times' — choosing to be candid. Warm but measured. The words land quietly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療職の野望を医療チームで前向きに語ります
lines.en: Yes, we discuss our professional aspirations constructively as a team.
lines.style: Affirmative with gentle emphasis on 'we.' Unhurried, almost reflective. Shows she values optimism in ambition, not dismissing it. Steady professional warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 処女作の医学書出版を、貴院、応援されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital supports her debut medical publication, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Observant, slightly impressed. Ren connecting dots — noticing the institutional support structure. Respectful curiosity. Not quite a compliment, but close.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者を侮辱しないよう医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Yes. We're rigorous as a team about never treating patients with disrespect.
lines.style: Firm conviction with quiet intensity. The word 'rigorous' lands with weight. Not defensive, but clear about core values. Close, intimate register — speaking to something that matters.
